/dgra yang de la g.yo med pas/ /'dud pa dngos po'i che ba yin/ /stobs bral mi yis khros ci phan/ /stobs ldan don la khro ci dgos/ /des na bya ba sgrub pa la/ khro ba don med rang sreg yin/ /sbyin pas bsdus na dgra yang 'du/ /sbyin med gnyen yang ring du spong*/ /ba yi 'o ma zad pa na/ /be'u bzung yang 'chor bar 'gyur/ /bya ba 'ga' la mkhas pa yis/ /gzhan dag shes pa'i nges pa med/ /chu las 'o ma 'byed shes pa'i/ /ngang pas gzugs brnyan zas su sgom/ /rtag tu byams pas skyong ba yi/ /rje bos bran g.yog rnyed par sla/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa dag /ma bsdus par yang ngang gis 'du/ /longs spyod ldan pas spyod pa dang*/ /mkhas par gyur nas dul ba dang*/ /chen pos dman pa legs skyong ba/ /gsum po gzhan bde rang la phan/ /bsod nams shugs kyis don bsgrub pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin ltos pa med/ /'bad pa'i shugs kyis don bsgrub pa/ /mar me'i 'od bzhin kun la ltos/ /chen po rnams la brten bcas na/ /dman pa rnams kyang chen po thob/ /ljon shing che la brten pa yis/ /'khril shing rtse mor phyin la ltos | | yon tan ldan la skyon yod kyang*/ /yon tan dga' rnams nye bar bsten | | char gyis mkhar la gnod na yang*/ /'jig rten pa rnams dga' ba bskyed | | yon tan med na cha lugs kyis/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus | | rta mchog 'gros dang mi ldan na/ /shin tu brling yang rin thang chung*/ / nor ldan blun po'i nang na mang*/ /dpa' bo gcan gzan khrod na mod/ /legs bshad mkhas pa'i khrod 'byin pa/ /dam pa 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /gang dang gang la de yod pa/ /de yis de yi grags pa thos/ /mkhas pa'i grags pa mkhas pa dang*/ /dpa' bos dpa' bo thos pa bzhin/ /chen po rnams kyis mchod bya ba | | dman pa rnams kyis brnyas par 'gyur/ /dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bo'i rgyan | | zla ba lha min zas su byed/ /rig pa glegs bam la gnas dang*/

/ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang*/ /brjed ngas can gyi bslab pa rnams/ / dgos pa'i tshe na slu ba mang*/ /blo ldan nor gyis 'byor na yang*/ /le lo can la mthon po dka'/ /rna ba thog mar skye na yang*/ /rwa rtse mtho ba ma mthong ngam/ khyi phag rnams la dri zhim dang*/ /dmus long ba la sgron me dang*/ /ma zhu ba la kha zas dang*/ /blun po rnams la chos ci dgos/ /yon tan can dang gser bzang po | | g.yul ngor dpa' dang rta bzang po/ /sman pa mkhas dang rgyan bzang po/ / gang du phyin pa de ru brin/ /blo dang brtson 'grus yod gyur pa/ /de yis bsgrub par mi nus gang*/ /sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /skya bseng bu yis bcom zhes thos/ /phal cher bu tsha'i spyod pa ni/ /rigs brgyud snga ma'i rjes su 'brang | khu byug phru gu byi'u khra ru/ /'gro ba brgya lam srid pa tsam/ /ri dang chu bo glang po rta/ /shing dang 'od zer nor bu rdo/ /skyes pa bud med rigs gcig kyang | | mchog dang dman pa'i khyad par yod/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i tshig tsam yang*/ /nyam chung rnams kyis bzod par dka'/ /go ḍa'i rgyal po'i tshig tsam gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i rgyal pau bcings zhes grag /bya ba 'bad nas kun bsgrubs kyang*/ /'grub pa bsod nams shugs la rag /tshong pas rgya mtshor ma rnyed pa'i/ /nor bu rgyal po'i mdzod na spyod/ /blun po'i byams sdang rtags kyis go

| sgrin po'i byams sdang log par ston/ khyi rgan 'dzum na dga' rtags te/ / gshin rje 'dzum na gsod pa'i rtags/ /nor gyi mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/ /rgyan gyi mchog ni thos pa ste/ /grogs po'i mchog ni mi slu ba'o/ /nor gyis ma gdung su zhig yod/ /rtag tu bde bar bsdad pa su/ / bde dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyang*/ /dbyar dgun bzhin du brje bar 'gyur | | nyam chung rnams kyi chen po'i ming*/ /bzung ba tsam la gzhan gyis bsrung | | sor mo'i phreng ba'i ming bzung bas/ /log 'dren phal gyis bsrung bar bshad/ /sems can gang dang gang 'brel ba/ /bya ba sngon gyi las kyis byed | | bya rgod phyi ba khur ba dang*/ /sram gyis 'ug pa mchod la ltos/ /longs spyod gsog par 'dod rnams kyis/ /'phel na gtang ba bsrung ba'i mchog /chu chen rdzing du sdugs 'dod na/ /'brid pa gzhag pa rdzing gi gsos/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las rang gzhan gyi tshul brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa drug pa'o// //bran g.yog nga rgyal che ba dang*/ /dka' thub ldan pa chas gzob dang*/ / rgyal po chos bzhin mi spyod pa/ /gsum po tshul min zhugs pa yin/ /mi lcogs bya ba rtsom pa dang*/ /mang dang 'khon zhing stobs ldan rtsod/ /bud med yid rton ngan dang mdza'/ /lnga po myur du brlag pa'i rgyu/ /nor med zas gos mchog 'dod dang*/ /gzhan la slong zhing nga rgyal che/ /bstan bcos mi shes rtsod par 'dod | | gsum po 'gro ba'i bzhad gad sa/ /yul bzang yod bzhin yul ngan la | | skye bo ngan pa phaungs shing chags/ /kem shu'i me tog sha yin zhes/ /ce spyang las gzhan su zhig re/ /chen po rnams la dgra bas kyang*/ /rang gi 'khor gyis gnod pa mang*/ /seng ge lus kyi 'bu min pa/ /srog chags gzhan gyis ga la za/ /rje bos bdag la gnod byed na/ /de la skyob par byed pa su/ /snang bas gzugs la sgrib byed na/

/de la lta ba'i thabs gzhan med/ /chos spyod zhi bar gnas pa la/ /'tshe byed shin tu tha shal yin/ /rang la skyabs 'ong bsad pa la// dpa' bo yin zhes su zhig sgrogs/ /skye ngan rang la mi phan yang*/ /gzhan la gnod par byed pa yod/ /sbrul gdug zas su rlung za yang*/ /pha rol mthong na mi gsod dam/ /'dod pa bde'o snyam sems kyang*/ /de spyod sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu | | chang 'thung bde'o snyam pa de/ /smyo ba bde bar bsgom pa yin/ /yon tan can la 'jig rten gus/ /yon tan 'bad pa'i shugs la gnas/ /'bad nas yon tan mi bsgrub par/ /gzhan la 'khangs pas ci zhig phan/ /mi rnams tshe ring pa la smon/ /rgas par gyur la 'jig par lta/ /rgas la 'jigs shing tshe ring bar/ /'dod pa blun po'i log lta yin/ /gang zhig mkhas pa yod bzhin du | | de la yon tan mi slob na/ /mi de gdon gyis btab pa'am/ /yang na las kyis mnar ba yin/ /gang la longs spyod yod bzhin du/ /spyod dam sbyin par mi byed na/ /mi de nad kyis btab pa'am/ /yang na yi dwags mngon sum yin/ / chos lugs shes kyang mi sgrub na/ /de yi chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs na yang*/ /gcan gza' dga' ba ga la skye/ /las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la/ /longs spyod yod kyang spyod mi nus/ /bya rog ltogs kyang bskungs mod kyi/ /'grangs par za bar ga la nus/ /spyod dam sbyin par mi nus pa'i | | nor des phyug por bsgom na ni/ /ri bo gser du bsgoms pa yis/ / phyug po bsgrub pa shin tu sla/ /chos dang chos min smra ba la/ /mkhas pa shin tu mang na yang*/ /de ltar shes nas nyams len pa/ /'jig rten 'di na shin tu dkon | | rigs gzugs lang tsho ldan na yang*/ /yon tan med na mdzes ma yin | | rma bya spu sdug yid 'ong yang*/ /chen po'i rgyan du 'os sam ci/ /sna yi tshab ma nyos pa'i bu/ /g.yar ba'i rgyan dang brkus pa'i nor/ /slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams/

/yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med/ /mi gang byas pa mi gzo ba/ /de ni gzhan pas rang la gnod/ /ltas ngan bsgrub pa nyes pa 'ga'// dgra yi thog mar rang la 'byung*/ /longs spyod 'grub par mthong na yang*/ / gnas ma yin las su zhig len/ /lug thug 'thabs pa'i khrag bldags pas// wa skyes mgo bo bkas zhes thos/ /'brel ba 'ga' yi ngor byas nas/ /gzhan la stes kyis dor mi bya/ /brgya byin yin yang 'khor 'dab rnams/ /ga bur bzhin du 'bros par 'gyur/ /rgyun du 'grogs pa'i grogs spangs nas/ / gsar bu 'ga' la yid mi rton/ /'ug pa'i rgyal pos bya rog gi /blon po bsten pas phung zhes grags/ /mi ngan 'bad pas bsten byas kyang*/ /rang gi mi ru 'gro ba med/ /chu ni ji ltar bskol gyur kyang*/ /me ru 'bar ba mi srid do/ /rgyu mtshan brtags nas khro ba ni/ /cung zad rigs zhing sel ba'ang shes/ /rgyu med par ni gang khro ba/ /de yi bsal thabs su yis shes/ /dgra bo'i nus pa ma brtags par/ /nyam chung na yang brnyas mi bya/ /da ṭi bha la brnyas pa yis/ / nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho bcom/ /bsod nams 'dzad na ngan sems skye/ / rigs 'dzad pa na bu ngan skye/ /nor 'dzad pa na brkam chags skye/ /tshe 'dzad pa na 'chi ltas 'byung*/ /rang gis ngan spyod ma byas na/ /brgya byin gyis kyang smad mi nus | | chu mig rang nyid ma skams na/ /sa yis mnan pas ga la thub/ /bya ba mi 'dra brgya phrag rtsom/ /mthar phyin bya ba gcig kyang med/ /blo rgod phal cher grong bar gyi/ khyi rgan 'dra bar rgyun du 'khyam/ /las kyi shugs kyis khrid pa na// blo chen log pa'i lam nas 'gro/ /mu stegs byed pa'i ston pa mchog /dbang phyug smyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /mi gang khrims las gang 'da' ba/ /re zhig rgyal yang pham pa yin/ /chu skyar khrims las 'das pa yis/ /sa kun thob kyang seng ges bsad/ /ha cang shes rab che drags pa'i/ /bya ba mang na bdag nyid brlag

/rgyal po dran rgya ches pa yis/ /rgyal srid nyams pa shin tu mang*/ / ha cang longs spyod bsags drag pa'i/ /nor ni rang gi gshed ma yin/ /phung khrol phal cher phyug po la/ /'byung gi sprang po bde ba rgyu/ /ha cang mthu rtsal che drags na/ /lceb pa'i lta gon byed pa yin/ /g.yul du bsad pa phal mo che/ / mthu rtsal can la byung ba mang*/ /'byor dang shes rab stobs la sogs/ /bsod nams ldan la grogs su 'gyur/ /bsod nams med na de dag kun/ /bdag nyid rlag pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /mkhas pas bya ba ci byed kyang*/ /rang gi bsod nams brtags te bya/ /rtsod dus bsod nams phun tshogs pa/ /skye bo brgya yi nang na'ang dkon/ /rdzing ngan chu yis khengs pa na/ /phyogs gcig ci nas 'jig pa ltar/ /gang la nor dang ldan gyur pa/ /de la rigs brgyud shin tu dkon | | bu dang ldan la nor chen dkon/ /de dang ldan na dgra bos 'joms/ / thams cad phun sum tshogs gyur na/ /mi de myur du 'chi ba mang*/ /des na mkhas pas bsod nams bsag /bsod nams kho na bde ba'i rgyu/ /su zhig gang na phun tshogs pa/ /de ni bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /brdzun gyis pha rol bslus so zhes/ /snyam na rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /lan gcig brdzun du smras pa des/ /bden pa smras kyang dogs pa skye/ /legs nyes rnam par mi dpyod par/ khros shing pha rol gnad 'bebs pa/ /chung ma bsad pa'i thi ba ltar | | grogs dang bral ba'i mya ngan thob//ma 'ongs pa la mi dpyod par/ /byung ba'i tshe na 'bad de btsal/ /chu dang 'phrad na lham 'phud kyis/ /ma 'phrad pa nas ga la 'phud/ /phugs su bsgrub par mi nus pa'i/ /bya ba legs kyang 'jug mi rung*/ khong pa'i nang du mi 'ju ba'i/ kha zas zhim yang su zhig za/ / rtsol ba dor nas 'dug pa la/ /'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'bad pa med na zhing bzang yang*/ /lo tog thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnas ma yin pa'i dul drags na/ /thams cad kyis ni bkol bar 'gyur/

/shing bal stan du byed mod kyi/ /yal ga su zhig stan du 'dings/ /bya ba ngan dang mi 'grub pa/ /pha rol bsgo yang byed na blun/ /sbyar dug nyo la su zhig rton/ /thams cad sbyin zhes su smra nus/ /nor rnams gsog cing mi spyod pa/ /rang bsreg bud shing gsog pa yin/ /bung ba sprang rtsi mi za bar/ /gzhan gyis khyer na lceb par rtsom | | legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las mi rigs pa'i tshul dpyad pa ste rab tu byed pa bdun pa'o// //blo ldan bya ba cung zad kyang*/ /rgyun tu graus kyis bsgrub par bya/ /'grub par gyur na lta ci smos/ /ma grub na yang mdzes pa'i rgyu/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pas/ /thams cad mgu ba sus kyang dka'/ /rang nyid yon tan ldan byas na/ /thams cad dga' ba de la nye/ /shin tu rgas par gyur tshe yang*/ /thos pa mang du bsag par bya/ /phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam/ /sbyin pa yis kyang ga la phan/ /yon tan kun rdzogs skye bo bsten/ /yang na tha mal 'grogs pa bde// bum pa chu yis gang ba 'am/ /yang na stong pa khur ba sla/ /yon tan cung zad bslabs pa'i mi/ /su zhig gis ni bsten par nus/ /chu phyed gang ba'i bum pa de | | mgo la bkur ba su yis nus/ /mi gang skye bo dam pa dang*/ /dman pa'i khyad par legs shes nas/ /de yi bya ba bsgrub shes pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi chen yin/ /blo gros ldan pas legs bskyangs na/ /skye bo dman pa'ang mchog tu 'gyur/ /slob shes dag gis ne tso la/ /bslabs na 'don pa shes par 'gyur/ /nyams stobs chung ba'i skye bos kyang*/ /chen po gzhan la brtain na 'grub | | chu yi thigs pa nyam chung yang*/ /mtsho dang 'dres na skems mi nus/ / rang la blo gros mi ldan na/ /blo chen gzhan la legs par 'dri/ /lag pas dgra bo mi sod na/ /mtshon cha len par mi byed dam/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo yang | | thabs dang ldan na grogs su 'gyur/ /dug chen lus la gnod mod kyi

|| sbyor ba shes na sman du 'gyur/ /rigs pas rnyed pa'i zas nor blang*/ /mi 'os gzhan la rlom sems spang*/ /shing thog shing rtse las blang gis/ /de las thal na sa la ltung*/ /mkhas pas sgrim pa mi byed pa/ /de yi bar la nyes pa 'byung | | blo dang ldan pas rab bsgrims na/ /nyes pa 'byung ba'i go skabs dka' | | ji srid rang stobs ma rdzogs par/ /de yi bar du dgra rnams bkur// nus pa rdzogs nas gang rigs pa/ /bya zhes bstan bcos gzhan dag smra/ /dgra bo snyan par smra na yang*/ /blo dang ldan pas yid mi brtan/ /chu skyar byi la des pa yis | | pha rol bsod la rtag tu brtson/ /yul gyi bdag po zhe sdang yang*/ /de la dga' bas brtain de bsdad/ /sa la rkang pa 'dred gyur na/ /sa nyid la ni brten pa bzhin/ /ha cang 'dod la brkam pa yis/ /skye bo myur du brlag par 'gyur | | mchil pa'i sha la chags pa yis/ /nya rnams de ma thag tu gsod/ / mchod 'os pa dang 'khor rnams kyang*/ /rtag tu sbyin pas bsdu bar bya/ /mchod gtor la ni lha rnams dang*/ /yi dwags bar du mgu bas bsrung*/ /chen po rnams kyis rtsed mo dang*/ /bde dang zas la chags pa spang*/ /'dod la zhen pa'i lai lan gyis/ /'bod sgrogs lang kar bsad ces grags/ /byams rtsod gnyis ka chen po dang*/ /bya yis dman dang nam yang min/ /nyo tshong rin chen la bya yi// sbyar dug la ni de ltar min/ /dpya ba mang phyir rgyal po'i mdzod/ /ha cang mi bsdu nyung ngus khengs/ /grog mkhar sbrang rtsi yar ngo yi/ /zla ba nyung ngu nyung ngus khengs// rje bos 'bangs la mi gnod par/ /rigs pa'i lam gy-i dpya rnams bsdu/ /sā la'i shing las spos kyi bcud/ /gzags pa mang na bskam par 'gyur/ /rje bos lhag par des pa dgos/ /rgyu mtshan chung ngus khro mi rung*/ /sbrul la nor bu yod na yang*/ /sems shes su zhig drung du sdod/ /gang zhig nor 'dod skye bos kyang*// chos nyid gtso bor bsrung bar bya/

/chos las nyams pa'i nor tsam ni/ /'jig rten 'dir yang ga la rtag /ha cang byams thal gnyen la'ang min/ /shin tu gnod chen dgra la'ang min/ /gnyen la re ba 'khon gzhi ste/ /gnod lan kun gyis sgrub par sla/ /'jam pos 'jam po 'joms byed cing*/ /'jam pos rtsub po'ang 'joms par byed/ /'jam pos kun 'grub de yi phyir/ /'jam nyid rno zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /su la'ang bdag gi dgra yin dang*/ /'ga' yang bdag la mi byams zhes/ /mi byams na yang de mi bsgrag /bsgrags na de nyid 'byed pa'i sel/ /ngo tsha khrail la mi lta zhing*/ /mchod dang brnyas pa'i khyad mi shes/ / zas dang nor la chags ldan pa/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bsdad mi bya/ /yul gzhan legs par ma brtags par/ /snga ma'i gnas ni dor mi bya/ /rkang pa ya gcig ma btsugs par/ /gnyis ka bteg na 'gyel ba'i rgyu/ /rang spyod 'bad pas sba bar bya/ /phal cher gsal bar bstan pas nyams/ /spre'u zlos gar mi byed na// mgul du thag pa ci ste 'dogs/ /nyes pa mngon sum mthong na yang*/ /gnas ma yin la smra mi bya/ /ltas ngan mthong na smra ba po'i/ /thog tu 'byung zhes 'jig rten sgrog /gzhan la brnyas par gyur ba yi/ /nor dang zas kyis ci zhig bya/ khyi phag mi gtsang za ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig yid smon byed/ /pha rol gnad du 'bebs pa'i tshig /dgra bo la yang smra mi bya/ /brag ca bzhin du rang nyid la/ / de ma thag tu le lan 'byung*/ /gal te dgra la gnod 'dod na/ /rang nyid yon tan ldan par bya/ /de yis dgra yang sems sreg cing*/ /rang yang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mi bsrun 'gro la byams sems bskyed/ /rtsub spyod kho nas gdul bar bya/ /rang gi lus la phan 'dod rnams/ /gtar dpyad kyis ni nad rnams 'don/ /gnod par byed pa chung ngu yang*/ /myur du bsal la 'dum par bya | | yur ba chung ngu'i rjes zhugs nas/ /'od pa chen po ma mthong ngam/ / mkhas pas bya ba ma yin pa'i/

/bya ba shes kyang mi bya'o/ /glang pos dgra sde bcom pa yis/ /rgyun du rgyal pos bcings la ltos/ /rang phyogs sdang yang spang mi bya/ /dgra bo byams kyang 'gu mi bya/ /bya rog bya rog gis 'tshe yang*/ /nyin mo long ba brtain na phung*/ /bya ba che chung gang byed kyang*/ /mkhas pas rtag tu bsgrims te bya/ /seng ges ri bong glang chen gnyis/ /gsod pa'i tshe na bsgrims klod med/ /yon tan ldan pa mi bkur ba'i/ /gnas der mkhas pa su zhig sdod || chu shel me rdor byed pa yi/ /yul der chu shel 'tshong ngam ci/ /mkhas pas gzhan la bshad pa 'am/ /yang na zhi ba'i nags su bsgrub/ /nor bu spyi gtsug rgyan byed dam/ /min na rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas/ /bdag pas mtho ba'i dam pa la/ /bsnyen na bdag la phan pa sgrub/ /lhun po'i ngos la gnas pa yi// bya rnams gser du snang bar 'gyur/ /chen po phrag dog ldan pa la/ /brten na chen po thob mi 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i 'od la nye ba yis/ /zla ba mar ngor gyur la ltos | | mi gang mdza' ba mi brtan pa/ /de dang 'grogs par su zhig nus// nam mkha'i gzha' tshon mdog mdzes kyang*/ /rgyan du re na blun po 'khrul// bdag nyid gang la mi dga' ba/ /gzhan la kun tu de mi bya/ /gzhan gyis cung zad gtsais pa'i tshe/ /rang la bsam pa ci byung soms/ /gang zhig bdag nyid gang dga' ba/ /de nyid gzhan la sbyar byas na/ /gzhan gyis bdag la gang dga' ba/ /de yi tshul gyis mchod par 'gyur/ /dmu rgod rnams dang mdza' ba dang

| | rtsod pa gnyis ka mkhas pas spang*/ /'gras pa dang ni 'dres pa'i tshul// gnyis ka bteg la byar mi rung*/ /dam pa dag la bstan pa dang*/ /mkhas pa dag la 'dri ba dang*/ /gzhung bzang po dang 'grogs pa ni/ /su la yod pa rgyun tu bde/ /dus su ma bab pa yi gtam/ /gang smra de la kun gyis brnyas/ /mang po smra ba'i gtan tshigs las/ /smyon par rjes su mi dpog gam/ /nyam chung rnams kyis rang nyid kyi/ /smra ba thams cad 'khrul bar bsam/ /de ltar go nas mi smra ba'i | | mi la gzhan gyis bkur ba nye/ /yul dang dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /rab tu bsgrims te lan 'ga' smra/ /legs bshad yin yang mangs gyur na/ /tshong zong lhag bzhin brin mi 'gyur/ /rang skyon mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ /skyon du go ba shin tu dka'/ /mang pos bdag la de sgrogs na/ /skyon can yin pa rjes su dpog /go yang skyon de mi 'dor na/ /mi de gdon gyis btab pa yin/ /da dung gnyen po mi 'jug na/ /mi yin snyam du ma sems shig /cung zad bsam pa yod rnams kyis/ /skyon de brnags la 'don par bya/ /de ltar gnyen po spyod pa yi | | mi de gong nas gong du 'gro/ /blo dang ldan pa'am byams kyang rung*/ /bsgo ba nyan pa'am dpa' yang rung*/ /gzhan gyi bya ba mi shes kyang*/ /de dang de yi spyod pas bskyang*/ /mi bsrun pa yi 'brel ba dang*/ /ring nas 'grogs kyang spangs na bde/ /rtag tu 'gul ba'i so bzang yang*/ /bton na bde zhes rgan po smra | | rgyun tu 'khang zhing 'khor ba yi/ /'brel ba cung zad byin la bskrad// sbrul gyis zin pa'i rma dag ni/ /gcod ma nus na srog dang 'bral/ /gal te chen po thob gyur na/ /phran tshegs gzhan la ser sna spang*/ /yul 'khor dbang du 'du ba na/ /dbyig la ser sna byed dam ci/ /mkhas pa longs spyod sogs 'dod na | | cha shas sbyin pa bsrung ba che/ khron pa'i chu ni 'phel 'dod na/ /'chu ba nyid ni gdams ngag yin/ /gang zhig phun sum tshogs 'dod na/

/de yis 'du 'god mang du bya/ /'du 'dzi sdug bsngal rgyur mthong na/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i re ba thongs/ /bya ba gang zhig bsgrub na yang*/ /skyon dang yon tan gnyis gnyis soms/ /gnyis ka mnyam yang spang dgos na/ /nyes pa shas che smos ci dgos | | mkhas pa drang po gus pas bsten/ /mkhas pa g.yo can shes na gzab | | rmongs pa drang po byams pas bskyang*/ /rmongs pa g.yo can myur du spang | | nor dang g.yog 'khor med na yang*/ /mdza' bo blo ldan grogs yod na || dud 'gros kyang ni don 'grub na/ /mi yi 'gro bas smos ci dgos/ /gang zhig shes pa'i bya ba bsgau /mi nus pa la 'ga' mi sbyar/ /chu la shing rtas mi bgrod de/ /thang la gru yis ji ltar bgrod/ /yun ring 'khon pa'i dgra bo dang*// mdza' ba byed kyang bsre mi bya/ /shin tu tsha ba'i chu nyid kyang*/ /me dang 'phrad na mi gsod dam/ /gzhung bzang ngo tsha khrel yod na/ /dgra bo la yang yid rton rung | | gzhung bzang dgra la skyabs song bas/ /srog gi bar du bskyab pa thos// rang la ngan sems med ces te/ /phal pa kun la yid mi brtan/ /ri dwags rgyun du sems bzang yang*/ /mche ba can rnams zas su bsgom/ /blun po log pa'i lam 'gro na/ /blun po nyid du go bas chog /mkhas pa log pa'i lam 'gro na | | rgyu mtshan gang zhig dpyad dgos so/ /mkhas pas longs spyod lhag sar sdad | | mi ster na yang 'phrog pa med/ /longs spyod nyams pa'i sa phyogs spang*// mi 'phrogs na yang gnya' skyis 'joms/ /rang gis legs par shes na yang*/ / bya ba thams cad gros kyis bsgrub/ /mi gang gros la mi dga' ba/ /'gyod pa rim gyis nyo ba yin/ /nyam nga'i gros dag byed pa na/ /mdza' yang gsum du gros mi bya/ /ro langs sgrub pa'i gros ngan na/ /thog mar sgrub po za bar 'gyur// len shes snyoms par gtong la mkhas/ /dul zhing kun gyi ngo bsrung ba/ / 'jigs med byas pa chud mi gsan/ /mi des 'dod na sa kun thob/

/gal te dgra bo skyabs 'ong na/ /de la mchod nas snyan pa brjod/ khwa das byi ba la brten nas | | bde ba thob ces sngon rabs smra/ /grogs po ngan dang thos pa ngan/ / rtog pa ngan dang bya ba ngan/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mi bya ste/ /byed na blun po gud na med/ /legs par brtags nas byed pa la/ /bya ba nyams pa ga la srid | | mig ldan brtags nas 'gro ba na/ /g.yang sar gom pa 'dor ram ci// rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /yon tan slob na mkhas pa'i rtags// rig pa 'ga' zhig mda' mkhan ltar/ /shes pa nyid na cho 'brang 'jig /rang nyid cis kyang mtho 'dod na/ /gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig gyis/ /byad la byi dor byed pa rnams/ /sngon du me long mi 'phyi 'am/ /pha rol ci nas bzhom 'dod na | | rang gi yon tan 'bad pas sgrub/ /dgra bo gsod par 'dod pa rnams/ / mtshon cha 'bad nas bsgrub la ltos/ /g.yo can tshig la dron 'jug pas/ /drang pos de la brtag dpyad dgos/ /bslus rjes kho bo drang ngo zhes/ /rang la bstod pas ci zhig phan/ /g.yo can sogs la g.yo sogs dang*/ /drang po sogs la drang po ste/ /mi brtan pa la brtan dgos zhes/ /bya ba sngon gyi yig tshangs yin// mkhas pas rtag tu dgra la yang*/ /gnyen des rkyen du bya na legs/ /de yis 'dum la mi phan yang*/ /nges par gnod sems 'jil ba'i sman/ /tshig ngan brjod pas 'jig rten du/ /'dod pa 'grub pa mi srid kyis/ /yid la rang 'dod bsgrub na yang*/ /ngag gis kun dang mthun par gyis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub na/ /'jam rtsub ji ltar byas kyang rung*/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la/ /g.yo sgyu thub pas ma gsungs so/ /tha mar shin tu phan pa'i gros/ / 'phral la sdug kyang mkhas pas bsten/ /rgas shing gdungs na yon tan rnams// bu gcig pa la mkhas rnams slob/ /longs spyod ha cang 'phel drags na/ /de la rgud pa shin tu nye/ /chu yis shin tu gang ba yi/ /rdzing bu stong ngam yang na 'dral//

skye bo 'ga' la phan pa'i las/ /la las de la 'jug mi rung*/ /sgog skya rlung la phan mod kyi/ /mkhris pa'i nad la dug tu 'gyur/ /nyam chung rtag tu bskyang dgos dang*/ /'grogs na chen po nyams dwogs yod/ /zhun mar snod du bzhag gyur na/ /snod la byi bas mi rmugs sam/ /ngan pa rnams la brten byas na/ / ngan pa'i shan gyis rang la gnod/ /yur ba'i chu la brten pa yi/ /nya rnams zhing la 'grems la ltos/ /gzhung ngan bdag la brten 'cha' na/ /de la cung zad byin te bskrad/ khyim du ltas ngan byung gyur na/ /nor las phri stai bzlog pa dgos//dam pa gzhan du 'gro na yang*/ /bsnyen bskur byas te nye bar bzhag /nor bu rin chen rtag mchod na/ /bkra shis dpal dang bsam pa 'grub/ /dman pa'i skye bo bstod drags na/ /phyi nas de nyid khyad du gsod/ /mkha' la mi gtsang gtor gyur na/ /'thor ba po yi spyi bor 'bab/ /skye bo blo ldan mgo smad na// smod byed nyid la nyes pa 'phog /mar me thur du kha bstan na/ /ston pa po yi lag pa sreg /gang dang gang gis gnas yin par/ /de dang de yi gnas su bzhag | gtsug rgyan rkang par mi gdags te/ /rkang pa'i rkang rgyan spyi gtsug min | | bya ba chen po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /'bad pa yis ni grogs bzang brten/ / nags tshal chen po mes bsreg na/ /rlung zhig ci nas grogs su dgos/ / byams pas khyab pa'i tshig smra ba/ /bsgrub sla gzhan dga' sdud pa'i mchog / nor gyis mgu bar su yis nus/ /lus srog btang yang phyed mi tshims/ /phongs kyang gdung bar mi bya ste/ /'byor yang dga' bas dregs mi bya/ /las kyi 'phen pa rgyang ring bas/ /skyid sdug sna tshogs da gdod 'byung*/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las bya ba brtag pa ste rab tu byaid pa brgyad pa'o// //'gro mgon sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhin du/ /ston pa gzhan la gus byed pa | | yan lag brgyad ldan chu 'gram du/ /ba tshwa'i khron pa brko ba yin/

/dngos po gang dang gang la yang*/ /goms na dka' ba ci yang med/ /bzo yi rig byed sbyangs pa ltar/ /dam chos dka' ba med par 'grub/ /gang zhig nyung ngus chog shes pa/ /de yi longs spyod zad mi shes/ /chog shes med pa tshol ba la/ /sdug bsngal char bzhin rgyun du 'bab/ /nam dgos tshe na len pa yi/ /nor ni sbyin par thub pas gsungs/ /bsags pa'i nor ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /nam zhig gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na bun btang bas/ /dngos po thob pa'i nges pa med/ /slong la byin na 'bad med par/ /chung yang brgya 'gyur thob pa yin | | 'jungs la phyug po mi srid cing*/ /gtong la dbul po mi srid pas/ / 'jungs pa nor dad chung ba dang*/ /gtong ba nor la rngam pa 'dra/ /byin na dbul gyur dogs pa yis/ /'jungs pas sbyin pa mi gtong la/ /ser snas nges par phongs 'gyur bas/ /blo ldan cung zad rnyed pa gtong*/ /bzhag na nor skyed mi 'phel bas/ /tshong pa zong rnams 'grems pa ltar/ /bsags na dbang phyug mi thob pas/ /mkhas pas tshong bzhin phyogs bcur ster/ /bye ba stong phrag gter yod kyang*/ /su zhig la yang gtong mi byed/ /de dag 'jig rten 'di dbul zhes/ /thos mang rnams kyis de skad bshad/ /rigs rgyud rgud kyis dogs pas na/ /blo chung cung zad rnyed pa sogs/ /mkhas pa rigs rgyud mtho thob phyir/ /gsug bzhin gzhan la sbyin pa gtong*/ /rigs rgyud phyug por bya snyam nas/ /rang nyid btsongs nas bu la ster/ /bu ngan pha la rgol bzhin du/ / nor rnams brlag nas khyi bzhin 'khyam/ /ji ltar pha ma bur byams kyang*/ /de ltar bu tshas pha ma min/ /pha mas bu tsha bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /pha ma rgas nas bu tshas brnyas/ /nor sogs 'jungs pa'i phyug po dang*/ /dgos sar gtong ba'i phyug po gnyis/ /rang dang rigs rgyud gnyis ka la/ /'jig rten gzhan gyis bye brag 'byed/ /srid pa'i khol por gyur pa rnams/

/srog dang bsdos nas nor phyir 'breng*/ /chog shes can gyis nor rnyed kyang*/ /des pa bzhin du gzhan la ster/ /bdog pa btang bas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /de la khro na bzod pa 'phel/ / tshim na rjes su yi rangs bsgaum/ /des na sbyin pa chos kyi mchog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i snod gyur pa/ /lus 'di dgra dang 'dra mod ky-i/ blo dang ldan pas 'khol shes na/ /'di la bsod nams rten du rung*/ /skad cig 'jig pa'i tshe na yang | | dge ba'i bag chags ring du 'khyer/ /rlung gis bsgos pa'i tsan+dan dri/ / ring du 'thul yang dga' ba skye/ /yun ring bde ba spyad spyad nas/ /'bral ba'i sdug bsngal lhag par che/ /rang dbang med par 'chi dgos pa/ /'di la rtag 'dzin de dag brlag /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor te/ /gcom bskyungs mig rtsa shin tu zhan/ /gang phyogs 'gro ba'i gtol med pa/ /de tshe dge ba gzhan rnams phung*/ /ngan song gsum po'i nad rnams ni/ /ma byung ba nas gso bar bya/ /gnam lcags mgo la bab pa ltar/ /thog tu bab na ci byar yod || mdza' bshes kun dang bral ba dang*/ /nges par 'chi ba shes bzhin du/ / da dung bde bar gnyid phebs pa/ /bdag nyid snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /gang gis brtson par mi nus kyang*/ /ci nas ngan 'gror mi ltung bya/ /dpa' bos dgra sde ma sod na'ang*/ /rang phyogs gsod par byed dam ci/ /'phral du cung zad sdug na yang*/ /rgyun du bde ba mkhas pas bsten/ /gtar bsreg dag gis nad 'don pa/ /sman pa mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /gal te gzhan dag phun tshogs pas/ /bdag gi yid la mi bzod na/ /de yis rang 'byor 'joms pa'i phyir | | rang la phrag dog byed par zad/ /gnod par bya phyir dgra 'joms na/ khyod kyis khro ba kho na choms/ khro bas 'khor ba thog med nas/ /bdag la gnod pa mtha' las 'das/ /gal te dgra kun brlag 'dod na/ /bsad pas de kun ga la 'dzad/ /rang gi khro ba gcig bcom pas/ /dgra kun cig car bsad pa yin/

/mthu chen gzu lum spyod pa la/ khros na rang la lhag par gnod | | dam pa nye bar zhi ba la/ khro ba bya rgyu ga la yod/ /sdong bu gcig las skyes pa yi/ /rtswa rnams rlung gis phyaugs bcur 'thor/ /de bzhin lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /skye bo las kyis so sor 'bral/ /sngon chad ma mthong 'brel bar 'thams | | de nas slar yang gzhan 'gro ba'i/ /mi de bdag dang cir 'brel na | | shi nas mya ngan chen po byed/ /rang don 'bad pas bsgrub 'dod na/ /de yis dang por gzhan don sgrubs/ /rang don kho na gtsor byed pa/ /de yis rang don 'grub mi srid/ /mi gang gzhan don gtsor byed na/ /g.yo can rang don sgrub pa 'dra/ /rang don 'ba' zhig gtsor byed pa/ /gzhan mgo 'don phyir drang ba 'dra/ /blo ldan tshe 'di bsgrub na yang*/ /chos kyis bsgrub na bde bar 'grub// dam pa rnams dang chom rkun gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par ltos/ /mi rnams tshe thung de yi phyed/ /mtshan mo gnyid log shi dang 'dra/ /na rga sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis/ /phyed po'ang bde ba spyad du med/ /skye bo kun gyi drung sdod pa'i// 'chi bdag gal te mngon sum mthong*/ /bya ba gzhan dag lta ci smos/ /za bar dran pa'i nus pa med/ khyod kyis bya ba zin nam zhes/ /'chi bdag sdod par mi 'gyur gyis/ /nges par bya dgos yod na ni/ /de ring nyid du brtun la gyis/ / bdag gi bya ba ma zin pas/ /re zhig de ring khyod bzhugs zhes/ /mchi mas brnangs te gsol btab kyang*/ /'chi bdag bcos su ga la rung*/ /'du 'dzi spangs pa bde ba ste/ /min na bzang po rnams dang 'grogs/ /dug sbrul gso ba ga la rung*/ /gso na bzlas brjod brtson par bya/ /sems ni rnam par g.yengs pa la/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i go skabs med/ /nye bar zhi bar gnas pa la/ / sems ni las rung shin tu nye/ /dmigs pa kun la rab mkhas shing*/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sems dul ba/ /'phags pa'i chos la rab sbyangs na/

/yon tan kun gyi zhing sa yin/ /blun po slob pa ngo tshar 'dzin/ /mkhas rnams ma bslabs ngo tshar 'dzin/ /des na mkhas rnams rgas gyur kyang*/ /phyi ma'i don du rig pa slob | | shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun po yon tan mi slob lo/ / brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis/ /blun pos 'bad pa lhag par dgos/ /skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pas/ /tshe 'dir blun por mthong nas ni/ /phyi mar blun por skye dogs pas/ /tshe 'dir dka' yang 'bad de mnyan/ /bsgoms na thos pa mi dgos zhes/ /blun po blo rgya chung ngu smra/ /thos pa med par bsgom pa tsam/ / 'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin/ /ma bslabs pa la kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /thos pa med pa'i bsgom pa de/ /re zhig grub kyang myur du 'jig /gser dngul legs par bzhu na yang*/ /me dang bral na sra bar 'gyur | | shes rab kyis ni gting brtags nas/ /nyes rgyu spong ba sgom pa yin// lus kyi dri ma bkrus pa ltar/ /bsgoms kyang ring zhig lon nas ldog /rgyu 'bras phul byung ma tshogs par/ /bdag med rtogs kyang 'tshang mi rgya/ /thabs mchog dag gis ma bsgrubs pa'i/ /bden par mthong yang dgra bcom yin/ / des na chos rnams legs rtogs te/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems bzhag na/ /nyes pa bag chags dang bcas pa/ /gang gis spangs pa rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /gang la blo gros mi ldan na/ /bstan bcos legs kyang su zhig len/ /nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi rgyan/ /mdzes kyang ba lang ga la lta/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis legs bshad kun/ /shin tu bden par go bzhin du/ /de don nyams su mi len na/ / bstan bcos shes kyang ci zhig bya/ /rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ / nyi ma re re tshig re zungs/ /grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /ring por mi thogs mkhas par 'gyur/ /legs par spyod la 'jug 'dod na/

/ci nas de yis kha mnyan te/ /dam pa kun tu sran btsugs nas/ /srog la bab kyang lugs bzhin bskyang*/ /de la 'bad pas gzhung lugs nas/ /'byung bzhin gnyen pos bsgrub nus na/ /mkhas rnams brdzun pa mi gsung gis/ /'di yi phan yon phyi nas ltos/ /sngon yang 'di bzhin spyad rnams 'phel/ /da lta na yang de ltar mthong*/ /gtan tshigs bzang po 'di yis ni/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang phun tshogs 'thob/ /blo ldan rang gis shes na yang*/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs gus pas blta/ /rin chen shin tu bzang po yang*/ /ma btsongs bar du rin thang chung

| | nags tshal shin tu mang mod kyang*/ /tsan+dan sa mchog skye ba nyung*/ /de bzhin mkhas pa mang na yang*/ /legs bshad 'byung ba shin tu dka'/ /rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes/ /gser dngul bzhu na shes par 'gyur/ /glang chen g.yul ngor shes 'gyur te/ /mkhas pa legs bshad rtsom na shes/ /gang zhig 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /rang la tshad mar byed 'dod na/ /de yis gzhung 'di legs brtags te/ /gnyen po bskyed la 'bad de bsgrub/ /'jig rten bya ba legs shes pa/ /de yis dam pa'i chos lugs 'grub/ /des na chos lugs spyod pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar yin/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las chos brtag pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa dgu pa'o// //'tsho byed zas su sgro btags nas/ /sman gyis nad chen gso ba ltar/ / 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gis dam pa'i chos 'di bstan | | thos pa rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'khrungs shing*/ /blo gros klu yi dbang pos legs bzung ba/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa rin chen gter | | blo gsal blo yi bang mdzod gang ba dang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi 'dod rgu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos dge ba'i yid kyis legs brtags nas/ /phyogs rnams gsal bar bya phyir 'di phye'o/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med/ /bsil zer byed pa'i 'od ltar rab gsal bas/ /skye bo snying gi mun pa phyir bsal te/ /blo gsal blo yi ku mud rgyas gyur cig /shes bya kun la rab sbyangs pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob bya'i phyir/ /des na bdag gi bstan bcos 'di/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir byas/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos | yul byang phyogs ky-i rgyud kha ba can gyi ljongs/ byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje'i gdan las dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas/ gtsang la stod grom pa dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du gnas pa/

'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis blo'i pad+mo'i ze'u 'bru cung zad kha bye bas/ sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi don yongs su grags pa phal mo che thos shing*/ rtogs nas khong du chud cing 'dris par byas pas/ lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag gi gnad phyin ci ma log par blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsom pa dang*/ rtsod pa la sogs pa'i tshul la spobs pa dge ba can/ shākya'i dge slong rigs par smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ dpal sa skya'i dgon par legs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //༄༅/ / ¡Ã gzhung lugs legs par bshad pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos ( ¡¶ lu ¡· grub mtha' rnam par 'byed pa ) bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ gran+daḥm taṃ su khyā ( ¡¶ zha ¡· khye ¡¶ lu ¡· + khyam̐ ) naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ gzhung lugs legs par bshad pa zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs sku gsum bdag nyid dam chos bden pa gnyis/ /rgyal sras phyir mi ldog pa mang po 'dus pa'i mchog /skyabs gsum skyabs kyi mchog gyur skyabs med kun skyob la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal rnam dag mchod pas mchod/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bstan pa rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung*/ /rin chen mnga' bdag dge 'dun gyi// 'bangs su bdag ni gzung du gsol/ /spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin spros pa sna tshogs kun/ /spros nas bshad na spros pa'i rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /spros dang spros bral dbyer med spros pa'i rim pa 'di/ /spros pa'i rgyan du 'gyur zhes bdag ni spro ba skyes/ /shes bya kun gyi gnas lugs la/ /blo ldan rnams kyi blo khyad kyis/ /bden brdzun 'di ltar 'byed do zhes/ /mdo tsam legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /rtog pa dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams gzhung lugs la mkhas par bya ba'i ched du 'di brtsam mo/

/'di la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba rnams na re/ nyer len gyi phung po 'di bden pa yin zhing | chu zla la sogs pa brdzun pa yin no zer ro/ /grub mthas blo bsgyur ba rnams na re/ rigs pas mi gnod pa ni bden pa yin zhing*/ nyer len gyi phung po la sogs pa ni brdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu yin zhes zer ro/ /de skad du yang spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten pa yis dngos mthong zhing*/ /yang dag nyid du'ang rtog byed kyi/ /sgyu ma lta bu min pas 'dir/ /rnal 'byor pa dang 'jig rten rtsod/ / ces so/ /rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis las/ 'jig rten pa'i lugs ni nye bar len pa'i phung po la gtsang ba la sogs par 'dzin zhing ngo tsha khrel yod kyis kun nas bslangs te/ lus ngag gi bya ba tshul dang mthun par sgrub pa ni skye bo ya rabs yin la/ ngo tsha khrail med kyis kun nas bslangs te yid du mi 'ong ba'i bya ba sgrub pa ni skye bo ngan pa yin no/ /de skad du yang lugs kyi bstan bcos dam pa'i rgyan las/ bkur bar 'os pa legs 'khur zhing*/ /mgon med rnams la lhag par byams/ /byas la drin lan mi brjed pa/ /dam pa rnams kyi mdzad spyod yin | | ngo tsha dor ba'i 'tsho ba dang*/ /sdig dang 'brel ba'i longs spyod dang*/ / mdza' bo bslus pa'i mnga' thang bas/ /dam pa rang nyid 'chi ba bas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'dam ) / /zhes pa dang*/ skye bo ngan pa sdig la dga'/ /byas pa drin du mi gzo ba// ngo tsha dgra bo bzhin du 'dor/ /rang don grub na ci yang byed/ /ngan pa ngan pa'i grogs kyis bskor/ /ngan spyod sna tshogs byas gyur te/ /dus kyis de las ma btub ces/ /ngan pa'i ngan shags dus la 'debs/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi gzhung lugs la mkhas par 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter la sogs par blta bar bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa'i lugs la gnyis te/ mu stegs pa dang*/

sangs rgyas pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su smra ba dang*/ gnyis su med par smra ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ rtag par lta ba'i phyogs la brten pa dang*/ chad par lta ba'i phyogs la brten pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ /'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ grangs can pa dang*/ phur bu pa dang*/ bye brag pa dang | rig pa can pa dang*/ gcer bu pa'o/ /grangs can ni/ drang srong ser skya'i rjes su 'brangs te/ mu stegs pa thams cad kyi phyi mo yin no/ /de skad du yang dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ de dbye cung zad cung zad la brten nas/ /mu stegs can mang lugs ni tha dad gyur/ /zhes so/ /de yang de kho na nyid grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga smra bas grangs can pa zhes bya'o/ /de skad du yang dbang phyug nag pos/ rang bzhin las chen de las nga rgyal te/ /de las tshogs ni rnam pa bcu drug 'byung*// de ltar bcu drug byung ba de las kyang*/ /de tsam lnga las 'byung ba rnam lnga 'byung*// zhes so/ /de'ang shes bya thams cad shes pa'i bdag shes rig gi skyes bu mtshan nyid lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ za ba po'am yul la longs spyod pa po dang*/ rtag pa yin pa dang/ byed pa po ma yin pa dang*/ yon tan med pa dang*/ bya ba med pa'o// de skad du yang 'jug pa las/ za po rtag dngos byed po min pa'i bdag /yon tan bya med mu stegs rnams kyis brtags/ /zhes so/ /de la za ba po ni/ rang bzhin gyis skyais bu yul la longs spyod pa'i 'dod pa skyes pa na/ yul sgra la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur rnams gtso bo'i khug ma nas bton nas de la skyes bu longs spyod pa'o/ /skyes bu de 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe za ba po zhes bya'o/ / skyes bu 'khor ba las thar ba'i tshe rtag pa zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa thams cad gtso bo'i khug mar zhi nas bdag gcig pu yan gar bar gnas pa'o/ /byed pa po ma yin te gang yang mi bskyed pas so/

/yon tan med pa ni rdul mun pa snying stobs gsum med pa'o/ /bdag des thams cad la ma khyab na ma khyab pa'i sar 'gro dgos pas bya ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba las/ yul dus thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir bya ba med pa'o/ /skyes bu des shes pa'i shes bya ba la gtso bo dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ rnam 'gyur las rdul mun pa snying stobs gsum cha mnyam par gnas pa'i tshe gtso bo zhes bya'o/ /de skad du yang spyod 'jug las/ snying stobs rdul dang mun pa zhes/ /bya ba'i yon tan mnyam gnas ni/ /gtso bo zhes byar rab brjod do/ /mi mnyam 'gro ba yin par brjod | | de la rdul ni sems yul la 'jug pa'i rang bzhin no/ /mun pa shes pa yul la kha mi phyogs par kun tu rmongs pa'o/ /snying stobs ni shes pa yul la gsal bar 'jug pa dang*/ myur du 'jug pa'o/ /rang gi ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ skyed byed gzhan gyis mi bskyed pa dang*/ rnam 'gyur bskyed pa ste | chos gsum dang ldan pas na rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /rnam 'gyur ni 'di lta ste | rang bzhin 'dre mo 'dra ba des skyes bu yul la zhen par byed pa ni rang bzhin las chen po zhes bya'o/ /de nas skyes bu de yul la yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'ong ba la sogs pa sems par byed pa ni/ chen po las nga rgyal zhes bya'o/ /nga rgyal ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i nga rgyal dang*/ snying stobs can gyi nga rgyal dang*/ mun pa can gyi nga rgyal lo/ /rnam 'gyur can gyi nga rgyal las de tsam lnga 'byung ste/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg de tsam mo// de tsam lnga las 'byung ba lnga 'byung ste/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'o | | snying stobs can gyi nga rgyal las dbang po bcu gcig 'byung ste/ las kyi dbang po lnga dang*/ blo'i dbang po lnga dang*/ gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can gyi yid kyi dbang po'o/ /las kyi dbang po lnga ni/ smra ba'i las la dbang byed pa ngag gi dbang po dang*/

ster ba'i las la dbang byed pa lag pa'i dbang po dang*/ 'gro ba'i las la dbang byed pa rkang pa'i dbang po dang*/ bshang ba'i las la dbang byed pa 'phongs kyi dbang po dang*/ ¡Ã ngal dang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - ngal dang ) 'khrig pa'i las la dbang byed pa mdom gyi dbang po'o/ /blo'i dbang po lnga ni/ mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ pags pa'i dbang po'o/ /mun pa can gyi nga rgyal gyis nga rgyal gong ma gnyis kyi graugs byed do/ /de la rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ni rgyu gang gis kyang ma bskyed pas rnam 'gyur ma yin no/ /chen po dang nga rgyal de tsam lnga ni rnam 'gyur phyi ma bskyed pas rang bzhin yin la rgyu snga ma las byung bas rnam 'gyur kyang yin no/ /dbang po bcu gcig ni nga rgyal las byung ba dang*/ 'byung ba lnga ni de tsam lnga las byung bas rnam 'gyur yin la 'bras bu gang yang mi bskyed pas rang bzhin ma yin no/ /skyes bu ni rnam 'gyur gang yang mi bskyed pas rang bzhin ma yin zhing*/ rgyu gang gis kyang ma skyes pas rnam 'gyur kyang ma yin no/ / de skad du yang ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + 'jug pa las/ ) / rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur min la/ /chen po sogs bdun rang bzhin rnam 'gyur zhing*/ /bcu drug po ni rnam par 'gyur ba ste/ /skyes bu rang bzhin ma yin rnam 'gyur min/ /zhes so// de ltar rang bzhin gyi gtso bo'i khug ma nas yul sgra la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur rnams bton nas skyes bus longs spyod de/ rnam 'gyur skyed byed kyi rang bzhin 'dre mo 'dra ba de skyes bus ma tshor ba de srid du skyes bu de 'khor ba pa yin no/ / skyes bu de rnam 'gyur la longs spyad pas skyugs log pa de'i tshe bsam gtan bsgom par byed de/ de bsam gtan la brten nas mngon par shes pas rang bzhin 'dre mo 'dra ba de mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba dang rang bzhin de ngo tsha nas 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu las logs shig tu 'bral bar byed do/

/ de dang bral bas des bskyed pa'i rnam 'gyur thams cad kyang skye ba'i rim pa las zlog nas de nyid du thim par 'gyur to/ /dbang po bcu gcig ni snying stobs can gyi nga rgyal du thim/ 'byung ba lnga de tsam lngar thim/ de tsam lnga rnam ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + par ) 'gyur ba'i nga rgyal du thim/ nga rgyal de nyid mun pa can gyi nga rgyal du thim | de blo'am chen por thim/ de gtso bor thim ste/ bdag skyes bu 'ba' zhig gsal bar gnas pa ni thar pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar gtso bo dang*/ chen po dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ de tsam lnga dang*/ 'byung ba dang*/ dbang po bcu gcig dang*/ skyes bu dang bcas pa ni de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ gang gis 'di ma shes pa ni 'khor ba pa yin la/ sngar bzhin du shes pa ni thar pa ste/ ji skad du/ khyab 'jug gi zhal snga nas/ ral pa'am byi bo'am cod pan gyi/ /cha lugs gang gis gnas kyang rung/ /de tsam nyi shu lnga shes na/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ / ces so/ /de ltar na skyes bu dang*/ gtso bo dang rang bzhin rnams ni rtag pa don dam pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ rnam 'gyur rnams ni mi rtag pa kun rdzob yin no zhes zer ro/ /de rnams ni gtso bo rgyur smra ba'i lugs yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod dang po/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 166PAGE 165
